story_text:
## Your power bank is doing 5% of its job.
A normal power bank does one thing — and sits idle the rest of the day. Checking stocks, weather or another time zone means unlocking your phone again and again, and your desk ends up cluttered with little gadgets.
## One device: charge, glance, and make it yours.
D1 is a power bank with a built-in Wi-Fi screen. Stocks, weather, your own photos — all on one little display on your desk.
## Smart Power, Everyday Ready.
80W fast charging, a live connected display, and your personal touch — all in one pocketable device.
## Product Reviews
## Your watchlist, always in sight — No app, no phone.
Glance at your favorite stocks without opening another app. D1 pushes supported market data straight to its screen, so your watchlist stays in view while you work.
## A color screen that does more than charge.
A vivid color display puts useful info and your own images right on your power bank — from stock quotes to daily updates.
## Turn it into a photo frame that's actually yours.
Upload any photo through the web dashboard and D1's screen becomes a personal desktop frame — whenever you want.
## Date, weather and humidity — at a glance.
See the date, local weather and humidity without reaching for your phone.
## Keep every time zone in view.
Show multiple time zones on one screen. Coordinating with overseas teammates, calling family abroad or lining up an international meeting — D1 keeps you on time.
## Set it up in the browser. No app to install.
No app to download. Configure D1 through a simple web dashboard — one less thing cluttering your phone.
## Connect once. Keep everything up to date.
Connect D1 to Wi-Fi and its screen keeps syncing — stocks, weather and the rest of your connected info.
## Up to 80W. Top up and get back to work.
Up to 80W output charges compatible devices fast, so you spend less time tethered to an outlet.
## One power bank for all your gear.
iPhones, Android phones, laptops, tablets, watches, earbuds and handheld consoles — D1 charges the USB-powered devices you use every day.
## 15,000mAh. Power that lasts all day.
A 15,000mAh (~55Wh) battery keeps phones, tablets and laptops going through work, commutes and time away from a plug.
## Plane-safe: ~55Wh, under the 100Wh limit.
At 15,000mAh / ~55Wh, D1 is below the 100Wh airline threshold — bring it in your carry-on with no questions asked.
## Charges in. Charges out.
D1 takes a charge and gives one — recharge the bank or power your devices, all in one compact companion.
## On when you look, off when you don't.
By default the screen sleeps after 34 seconds to save power. Double-click the button for an always-on mode that lasts up to 2 hours.
## See the charge happen in real time.
Watch power and current on D1's display and know exactly how your devices are charging.
## Brightness you control.
Dial the screen brightness up or down to match any room, from a bright office to a dim desk at night.
## Lighter than a paperback.
At about 10.6 oz, D1 slips into a bag, sits on a desk or rides your commute — real portable power, no bulk.

faq.q: Does the screen need constant WiFi? Can I use it offline?
faq.a: Yes, it works fully as a standard power bank without WiFi, showing basic battery level and time. Stock, weather and auto time-sync features require WiFi to update data.

faq.q: Which stock markets are supported? How many stocks can I add?
faq.a:
It supports major global markets. You can add custom ticker codes, with up to 5 entries displayed on screen at once.
*Data is for reference only and does not constitute investment advice.

faq.q: How often does stock data refresh?
faq.a: By default it auto-refreshes every minute when connected to WiFi. Refresh rate may vary based on network conditions and can be adjusted in backend settings.

faq.q: Does weather use location? Can I switch cities manually?
faq.a: Yes, it auto-locates via WiFi to sync local weather, temperature and humidity, and you can also manually add or switch target cities.

faq.q: Can I add my own cities to the world clock?
faq.a: Yes, you can select from major global cities in the backend, with up to 4 time zones displayed simultaneously.

faq.q: How do I set custom wallpaper? What formats and specs are supported?
faq.a: Upload images via the web backend. Only JPG format is supported, with a screen resolution of 320×240 pixels. Name your files as image.jpg, image1.jpg, image2.jpg, image3.jpg, etc. for the device to recognize them.

faq.q: Does the screen support brightness adjustment?
faq.a: The screen auto turns off after 12 seconds by default. To enable always-on mode, simply double-press the button. You can switch between modes based on your usage scenario to reduce battery consumption.

faq.q: Does the screen support brightness adjustment?
faq.a: It supports multiple brightness levels. At low brightness, the display is soft and non-glaring for nighttime use. Double-click the button to activate always-on mode, which keeps the screen lit for 2 hours.
It supports PD3.0, PPS, QC and other mainstream fast-charging protocols, compatible with most major smartphone brands.

faq.q: Can it charge laptops? Which models are supported?
faq.a: 65W single-port output can charge most ultrabooks and lightweight laptops. High-power gaming laptops are recommended for emergency use only.

faq.q: Can both ports charge at the same time? What's the total output?
faq.a: Yes, dual ports can output simultaneously. When both ports are active, only the USB-A port maintains fast charging with a maximum output of 80W; the USB-C port switches to 5V output at 15W (5V 3A).

faq.q: How long does it take to fully recharge itself?
faq.a: Approximately 75 minutes when using a 65W PD charger under lab conditions. Actual time may vary.

faq.q: How many times can it charge an iPhone?
faq.a: For an iPhone 14 Pro Max, approximately 2.2 full charges via USB-C wired output under lab conditions. Results vary by device model and usage.

faq.q: What's the difference between 15000mAh cell capacity and 9500mAh rated capacity?
faq.a: 15000mAh is the internal cell capacity. 9500mAh is the actual usable output capacity at 5V, which follows standard industry labeling practices.

faq.q: Does it support low-current mode for earbuds and watches?
faq.a: Yes, low-current mode is compatible with wireless earbuds, smartwatches, noise-canceling earbuds and other small devices.
